name: keysnag
description: keysnag: cybersecurity for AI founders and vibe coders. A pre-push security gate for apps built with Claude Code, Cursor, Lovable and Bolt. 12 deterministic, local-only checks; blocks on critical.

plugins.name: keysnag
plugins.description: Pre-push security gate: secrets, RLS, authz, injection, payments, backdoors, AI endpoints, CVEs, storage, live-URL probes, cross-account test. /security-check command, auto-runs on git commit/push.
